caption: The drawing depicts a bonnet in a three-quarter view, predominantly colored in a muted mauve or dusty rose. The bonnet's surface displays a quilted pattern with zigzag stitching in a slightly darker shade. The rounded crown and front brim are both quilted, and the body of the bonnet is gathered at the back, giving it a pleated appearance. A ruffled section is present along the lower back edge. A thin green ribbon, partially visible, emerges from the underside of the bonnet, likely intended for tying under the chin. The inner lining of the bonnet is pale yellow. The background is a plain, unadorned light beige color. The artist's signature, "FLORENCE EARL," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Baby's Hood
